To get the best results with your Blundstones, we recommend pairing them with a few key items:

Leather care products: Use our Renovating Creams (black, brown, or rustic) on appropriate leather types to nourish and condition your boots. Avoid using these creams on nubuck, suede, PVC, or nylon.
Waterproofing spray or wax: Regularly apply a waterproofing spray or wax to enhance moisture resistance, and always let boots dry naturally away from direct heat if they get wet.
Appropriate cleaners by leather type: Use nubuck/suede brushes, gum erasers, and nubuck/suede-specific cleaners for those finishes, and soft brushes or cloths for full‑grain and rustic leathers.
Replacement insoles/footbeds: Our Comfort Classic, Comfort Arch, and Sheepskin Footbeds can be purchased separately and matched to your boot size to refresh comfort and support.
True Fit + Size Guide: When purchasing, combine our True Fit tool with the Size Guide to help ensure you’re pairing your foot with the best‑fitting size for long‑term comfort.

Using the correct care products and insoles alongside your boots will help maximize comfort, durability, and weather protection.
